thesis: PRE-MARKET (07:30 ET) read on Friday 2026-08-21, roughly two hours before the open, positioning for today's session off the completed Thursday 2026-08-20 bar. Structure first: the multi-month frame is intact. SPY 762.6 keeps its deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (swing-structure-lab Bull-stacked, fast 760.99 over slow 707.13), +1.58% above its 50-day (~750.7) and +8.24% over its 200-day (~704.5), mom126/252 +12.01%/+20.51%, pctFrom52wHigh -1.96, so price is about 2% under the highs rather than a break, though swing-structure-lab still qualifies a Double top pattern and reads its own trend regime as unknown. The prior session set the near-term tone: intraday-tape-lab reads the 8/20 session a Trend day (down auction) under Mixed control, VWAP 764.84, gap -0.41%, 79 bars. The dealer map improved into this window: options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (spot 765.2) read signed net GEX -0.63B, far shallower than the -5.28B after-hours print, with the flip 765.51 and the spot sitting right at it between the 765 put wall and the 770 call wall, so the negative-gamma pocket has nearly closed and SPY is at the pivot rather than trapped below it. The honest counterweight is the priced move: the front expected move widened to ±8.21 with atmIV 28.98% (from ±3.65 / 12.92%), reading far wider than the calm VIX 15.7 headline, a front-expiry implied-move expansion to treat as the owner's priced range and re-pull before leaning on it. Breadth stays narrow: market-heatmap-lab reads 29.99% of 134 (narrow, margin -30.01) on the 8/20 bar; counting persistence by distinct market-bar dates the sequence is 55.23% on 8/18, 64.33% on 8/19 and ~30% on 8/20, so only one of the last three bars cleared 60% and the latest is below the line. Flow stays defensive: options-flow-feed-lab is put-heavy (callFraction 0.2473, call premium $1.401B against put premium $4.263B across 12 tickers, 1942 contracts over the $250k bar) with an AVGO 420 PUT ($46.2M, 12.3x open interest, 1DTE) the most-unusual print, plus a SPY 766 PUT ($228.4M, 138.3x open interest, 0DTE) and an AMD 550 PUT. The near-term leaders stay soft: SPMO 148.31 is -1.61% below its 50-day (~150.7) while holding +13.55% over its 200-day (~130.6), QQQ 710.93 is -0.28% below its 50-day (~712.9) and XLK 183.1 sits on its 50-day (~182.9). VIX eased to a calm 15.7 and volatility-sizing-lab reads NORMAL (conditional vol 12.2052%, throttle x1.23). Leadership tilts toward energy and defensives (XLE at its 52-week high with the highest sector rsMom 102.11, XLV Leading, XLU/XLP Improving, XLF weakening), the global tape is Asia-led (EWS Singapore 87.5 vs ACWI) and real-asset leadership is crypto-led (ETH-USD 74.2, BTC 71.9, GLD firmer at 48.4). Structure first, tactical noise last: HOLD the intact structural SPY/SPMO core and the first beta-add tranche while narrow breadth keeps the remaining tranches paused, tilt the sector book toward the Leading energy/healthcare and Improving defensives funded from weakening financials, HOLD (not chase) MSFT, and carry only a SMALL day tail now that dealer gamma is near flat at the flip.
